# Disagreement Log — Gospel of Thomas, Saying 52

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** GTH 052
**Total Disagreements:** 2

---

## Disagreement 1 — "set aside" vs. "ignoring"

**Verse:** v.2
**LOGOS:** "set aside"
**PNEUMA:** "ignoring"
**Issue:** *Khaaef* = to leave/dismiss/set aside; an active decision to put something to one side. "Ignoring" is passive. "Set aside" is the deliberate displacement.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Set aside" retained.

---

## Disagreement 2 — "in your presence" vs. "right in front of you"

**Verse:** v.2
**EMET/LOGOS:** "in your presence"
**PNEUMA:** "right in front of you"
**Issue:** *Mpetnaho* = "before your face." The formal idiom "in your presence" preserves the face/presence register; "right in front of you" is too casual.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "In your presence" retained.

---
